description: &eElemental casting:&r Iron's Spells schools (fire, ice, lightning, holy, ender, blood, evocation, nature).

Mageslayer (Starlit Voidglass) is the anti-caster gem. Inks: Ancient Core = epic, Starforged Heart = legendary.
